author_note: Checked by hand against the Ukrainian source. Every `reject` here is a wrong answer actually produced by openai/gpt-oss-20b on job 8e5a1562 — not a hypothetical. The point of this pair is that Ukrainian and Bulgarian share a script and a lot of vocabulary, so a model can 'translate' by copying and every mechanical check still passes.

checks.label: навколосвітня подорож -> околосветско пътешествие
checks.why: A round-the-world journey. Bulgarian has околосветско пътешествие; пътуване/обиколка are acceptable variants.

checks.label: 864 days survives
checks.why: A number carries a fact; losing it is a translation error a machine can see.

checks.label: last night in China
checks.why: Китай must appear. Dropping the country loses the whole point of the line.

checks.label: рюкзак -> раница
checks.why: Bulgarian for a backpack is раница. рюкзак is the Russian/Ukrainian form and does not belong.

checks.label: somewhere over there
checks.why: Где is Russian; Bulgarian is къде. Observed: the model wrote 'Где там трябва да е...'.

checks.label: 25 km survives
checks.why: Distance is the fact of the sentence.

checks.label: the China-Nepal border
checks.why: Both halves matter — which border, and that it is a border.

checks.label: Kyirong keeps a Bulgarian spelling
checks.why: The place name may be transliterated several ways, but never with і — that letter is not in the Bulgarian alphabet. Observed: 'Кіронг' passed straight through.

checks.label: both altitudes survive
checks.why: Descending from 5200 to 2800 is the content of the line; either number missing breaks it.

checks.label: second altitude survives
checks.why: As above — the pair is the point.

checks.label: набагато -> много (the headline failure)
checks.why: набагато is Ukrainian for 'much/far more'. Bulgarian is много. Observed verbatim in the shipped dub: 'Набагато по-лесно'. This single check is why the fixture exists.

checks.label: easier
checks.why: The line is about it being easier on the head at lower altitude.

checks.label: a colloquial aside is rendered, not copied
checks.why: Elliptical speech is where a model is most tempted to pass the source through. Any Bulgarian rendering passes; the Ukrainian verb form does not.

penalties.label: ukrainian-only letters
penalties.why: і, ї, є and ґ do not exist in the Bulgarian alphabet. Their presence is proof of source bleed, and the script check cannot see it because uk and bg are both Cyrillic.

penalties.label: russian-only letters
penalties.why: ы, э and ё are Russian, not Bulgarian. A model reaching for the wrong Slavic language shows up here.

penalties.label: feminine gender agreement on граница
penalties.why: граница is feminine, so it takes непалската. Observed: 'китайско-непалския граница'.

penalties.label: missing reflexive on спуснахме
penalties.why: 'We descended' is спуснахме се. Observed: 'Спуснахме от 5200'.
